card.name: Weight-loss drug labels, word before indication
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation right after a weight-loss or anorectic drug name (phentermine, bupropion, diethylpropion, Contrave), where a weight-loss or diet term could come next.

modes.label: Link word after drug
modes.description: A word like for, with, or taking that follows an anorectic drug and leads to weight loss or cessation use.

modes.label: Comma after drug name
modes.description: A comma right after a weight-loss drug name in a list or aside.
modes.example: including phentermine<<,>> have not been established.

modes.label: Inside phentermine or dose text
modes.description: Partway through the drug name or a dose number in weight-management labels.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward diet and weight words next, and away from unrelated rare tokens.
card.plain: It fires on small words after weight-loss drug names, just before text about diet or weight loss.
